# Problem 1
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

The `penguins` dataset has information about penguins, such as species, island, bill length, flipper length, body mass, sex, and year. The species are `r paste(levels(penguins$species), collapse = ", ")`. The islands are `r paste(levels(penguins$island), collapse = ", ")`. There are `r nrow(penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns. The mean flipper length is `r round(mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2)` mm.

```{r}
flipper_bill_plot =
  ggplot(
    penguins,
    aes(
      x = bill_length_mm,
      y = flipper_length_mm,
      color = species
    )
  ) +
  geom_point()

flipper_bill_plot

ggsave(
  "flipper_bill_scatterplot.png",
  plot = flipper_bill_plot
)
```
